stats.notes: Confirmed one input-race bug. Pausing in the same tick as a movement key still moves the player: pause+left (after one right step) produced events [pause, move] and the player went from (2,1) to (1,1), while the design says the rest of the tick's input is ignored once paused. Reproduced in run 2 and in run 1 (same seed, same token). Not yet tested: other items, lever/gates, timer, heart cap, dialog Enter/buttons, and restart. Budget left is ample, but I stopped here to keep the single confirmed report clean.
